title: RUHI RULES — A Little Piece Of Me
body:
**A little piece of me. A little piece of you.**

*Somewhere between who I was, who I am, and who I am becoming, I found the words.*

Welcome to Ruhi Rules.

I don’t know what brought you here.

Maybe you were looking for poetry.
Maybe you were looking for something beautiful.
Or maybe, like me, you’ve spent a little too much time trying to find the right words for feelings that never quite fit into ordinary conversations.

Whatever brought you here, I hope you stay a while.

This is a space for the things we don’t always say out loud.

For the almosts and the never-weres.
For the dreams we whisper when the world is asleep.
For the versions of ourselves we outgrew, and the ones we’re still learning to love.

Here, I write about life as I have experienced it.
Not always gracefully.
Not always with all the answers.
But always with a little more honesty than I knew how to offer before.

Some of these words will make you feel understood.
Some might remind you of someone you once loved.
Others may bring you face to face with a part of yourself you’ve been avoiding.

And that’s okay.

You don’t have to arrive here with everything figured out.

You just have to be willing to feel.

So take your time.
Read a little.
Stay a little longer.

And if, somewhere between these lines, you find a piece of yourself…

Then perhaps these words were always meant to find you.

**Welcome home.**

— Ruhi
